title: Zoning map change for 21-31 46th Avenue, Long Island City
summary: This application would rezone a site at 21-31 46th Avenue in Long Island City, Queens from an M1-4/R6B district to an R7X district with a new C2-5 commercial overlay. The change would help enable an 11-story mixed-use building with ground-floor retail and about 84 apartments, including 21 income-restricted units. The City Council's Land Use Committee recommended approval on September 24, 2026.
